svg.text: DDIA 13 · A PHILOSOPHY OF STREAMING SYSTEMS
No one database does everything: a source of truth plus derived views, connected by logs, with correctness checked end to end.
Every other store is a derived view, like an index or
materialized view, except in separate specialized systems. Any
view can be dropped and rebuilt by replaying the log.
Kappa: one stream path, reprocess by replay
Kappa: one streaming codebase. To fix a bug or change logic,
start v2 reading the log from the beginning, let it catch up,
Like a third rail for two track gauges: run old
and new side by side, reprocessing history into
the new schema, so every step can be undone.

"How do you guarantee no double charge?"
Client idempotency key + unique constraint + the payment provider's idempotency + a daily reconciliation job against provider settlement files.
"Search is a derived view. Timeliness can lag seconds; the checkout price is read from the source of truth (integrity)."
"How would you change the aggregation logic?"
Kappa: deploy v2 consumer from offset 0 to a new table, compare, switch.
